batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2016-2017, Set-4 — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading (with zoomed crops) of Part 2 of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.186-192 (printed pp.1-7 of Part 2). Part 2 has NO answer table: each question carries its key inline, as an '[Ans: x]' tag and/or a printed worked solution ('সমাধান:'/'Solution:'); the two forms never disagree in this paper. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. The paper is printed in two syllabus tiers whose question numbers interlock: the 'Short Syllabus' run (banner on book PDF p.186) carries 67 questions and the 'Extra Syllabus' block (heading on book PDF p.191, continuing on p.192) carries the remaining 13 (Q12, 13, 19, 21, 22, 23, 69, 71, 72, 73, 74, 76, 80); together they partition the printed numbers 1-80 exactly once, and each question's tier is recorded in its topic field. The book prints no per-subject headings; subject blocks follow the printed question-number ranges, confirmed by content: Bangla Q1-3, English Q4-6, General Knowledge Q7-14, Physics Q15-36, Chemistry Q37-58, Higher Mathematics Q59-80 — counts Bangla 3, English 3, General Knowledge 8, Physics 22, Chemistry 22, Higher Mathematics 22. Question numbers are NOT printed in numeric order across the pages: p.186 carries Q1-11, 14-16; p.187 carries Q17, 18, 20, 24-33; p.188 carries Q34-47; p.189 carries Q48-59; p.190 carries Q60-68; p.191 carries Q70, 75, 77-79 and (Extra Syllabus) Q12, 13, 19, 21; p.192 carries (Extra Syllabus) Q22, 23, 69, 71-74, 76, 80. Keys: 76 keyed single_choice, 0 dual keys, 0 keyless, and exactly FOUR printed no-correct-option dispositions — Q18 and Q28 (printed solutions headed 'সমাধান: (No Answer)'), Q22 (Extra Syllabus, 'সমাধান: (No Answer)') and Q31 ('সমাধান: (সঠিক উত্তর নেই)'); those four carry answerDisposition 'no_correct_option' with correctOptionIds [] and answerVerificationStatus 'verified' solely because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition — it records the book's own printed claim (the printed solution's no-answer statement), not cross-source verification — while their contentVerificationStatus remains 'unverified' like every other question in this extraction-stage pack. Preserved print anomalies: Q6 options (b) and (d) both print 'Secretariet' identically; Q34 options (a) and (b) both print 1.928 s identically; Q17's stem prints 'অবস্থার ধ্রুবক' for the decay constant; Q20's stem prints the digit 0 with no complement bar; Q26(d) prints '931KeV' with no space; Q31(a) prints its exponent as +6 (118.6 × 10^6 N); Q39(a) prints the equilibrium constant as Ke (subscript e); Q42(d) prints 6.023 × 10^33; Q46(a) prints 'ΔH = ΔU + PΔ' with no V after the second Δ; Q47(a) prints 'CH3 COOH' with a space and Q47(c) prints '10%CH3COCH3' with no space after the percent sign; Q51(d) prints '(CH3)3CHO' (the central C does not appear); Q69(c) prints a duplicated 'n' in the superscript ('^(n+2n)C_r') although its printed solution computes ^(n+2)C_r; Q63's printed solution keys (d) while adding that the question is flawed because r is never negative; Q19's content is general-knowledge flavoured although its printed number places it in the Physics block. No question in this paper carries a figure or diagram (a small sign-bit diagram appears only inside Q23's printed worked solution). BOUNDARY NOTE: book PDF pp.193-199 (printed pp.8-14) are NOT part of this paper — they carry the next paper, JU A Unit 2016-2017 Set-12 (header 'সেট-12' on book PDF p.193), and are excluded here. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: Udvash জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক (JU A & D Unit question bank)
sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. The book's Part 2 (typeset প্রশ্ন-সমাধান section, banner 'প্রশ্ন-সমাধান: ২০১৬-১৭') restarts pagination: printed page = book PDF page - 185. Set-4 of JU A Unit 2016-2017 occupies printed pp.1-7 = book PDF pp.186-192: 'Short Syllabus' run on pp.186-191 (banner on p.186) and the 'Extra Syllabus' block beginning at the foot of printed p.6 (book PDF p.191) and continuing on printed p.7 (book PDF p.192). There is no answer table in Part 2; keys are inline ('[Ans: x]' tags and printed 'সমাধান:'/'Solution:' worked solutions printed directly under each question). Paper header (book PDF p.186) confirmed before transcription: জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৬-২০১৭ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান: ৮০, ইউনিট-A, সেট-4, সময়: ১:০০ ঘণ্টা. The following paper, Set-12, begins on printed p.8 (book PDF p.193). Transcription by direct visual reading of every page image, with zoomed re-reads (PIL crops at ~200%) for Q2, Q5-Q6, Q8, Q17-Q18, Q20, Q24-Q31, Q34, Q36-Q39, Q42-Q47, Q49, Q51-Q57, Q61-Q69, Q70-Q80 and the Extra Syllabus blocks. Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π, matrices wrapped in [...] with rows separated by ';', unit vectors as î, ĵ, k̂ and vector arrows as →; chemical formulas written with plain digits for subscripts, e.g. H2SO4; isotope mass/atomic numbers written as left plain numbers, e.g. 14_7N).
